top_findings: Site is NOT indexed in Google — zero results for site: search
Zero structured data (JSON-LD/Microdata/RDFa) on entire site
AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended + 5 more) blocked by Cloudflare edge — not in repo
Missing og:image and twitter:image despite declaring summary_large_image card
No HTTPS enforcement — HTTP serves 200 OK directly (no redirect)
quick_wins: Enable 'Always Use HTTPS' in Cloudflare dashboard (2 min)
Unblock GPTBot + ClaudeBot + Google-Extended in Cloudflare AI Crawl Control (5 min)
Submit sitemap to Google Search Console (10 min)
Add favicon to public/ directory (15 min)
Fix canonical trailing-slash mismatch in sitemap.xml (2 min)

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Fully server-rendered HTML (is_spa: false, no JS required for content)
Valid sitemap.xml with current lastmod date
Proper 404 handling (HTTP 404 + noindex meta)
Brotli compression active, HTTP/2 enabled
Clean URL structure, responsive viewport meta
137+ Tailwind responsive breakpoint classes

findings.title: No HTTPS enforcement
findings.description: http://rahul.techiking.com/ returns 200 OK instead of redirecting to HTTPS. Site fully accessible over unencrypted HTTP — duplicate content and security risk.
findings.recommendation: Enable 'Always Use HTTPS' in Cloudflare SSL/TLS → Edge Certificates

findings.title: No HSTS header
findings.description: Strict-Transport-Security header absent on HTTPS response. Combined with no HTTPS redirect, leaves site exposed to protocol downgrade.
findings.recommendation: Enable HSTS in Cloudflare with max-age=86400 initially, add includeSubDomains

findings.title: Zero security response headers
findings.description: No CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy headers.
findings.recommendation: Add via Cloudflare Transform Rule / Response Header modification

findings.title: Canonical/sitemap trailing-slash mismatch
findings.description: Canonical tag: https://rahul.techiking.com (no slash) vs sitemap: https://rahul.techiking.com/ (with slash). Both URLs return 200 with no redirect.
findings.recommendation: Standardize on one form and redirect the other via Cloudflare edge rule

findings.title: Missing favicon
findings.description: /favicon.ico returns 404. No <link rel='icon'> in HTML. Affects browser tabs, bookmarks, SERP display.
findings.recommendation: Add favicon.ico + apple-touch-icon to public/ directory

findings.title: No IndexNow integration
findings.description: No IndexNow key file or deploy-time ping configured.
findings.recommendation: Add key file to public/ and ping on each deploy for faster Bing/Yandex reindexing

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Strong E-E-A-T: real experience (4.5+ years), specific metrics, verifiable certifications
5 detailed project case studies with problem/solution/impact
Interactive SRE Incident Simulator — genuinely differentiating
~3,500-4,000 words of substantive technical content
Good heading hierarchy (1 H1, 8 H2s, logical H3 nesting)

findings.title: Site not indexed in Google
findings.description: site:rahul.techiking.com returns zero results. The domain has no discoverable presence in any search engine.
findings.recommendation: Submit sitemap to Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools immediately

findings.title: Content too fragmented for AI citation
findings.description: All content is in short bullet-point fragments, not self-contained 134-167 word paragraphs optimal for AI extraction and citation.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite key sections as citable paragraphs with direct-answer openers

findings.title: No FAQ section
findings.description: No question-phrased headings or FAQ content for featured snippet and AI answer eligibility.
findings.recommendation: Add 3-5 FAQ questions that recruiters and AI systems would ask about this candidate

findings.title: Resume dated March 2025 — appears stale
findings.description: resumeLastUpdated field shows 'March 2025' (1.5 years ago). May raise freshness concerns.
findings.recommendation: Update to current date in src/data/portfolioData.ts

findings.title: Keyword stuffing risk from ATS Keywords section
findings.description: ATS Keyword Index section displays 30 keyword badges that may trigger keyword-stuffing detection.
findings.recommendation: Integrate keywords naturally into content rather than displaying as a flat badge list

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Title tag: 57 chars, includes name + primary role keywords
Meta description: 153 chars, includes key roles and cloud platforms
Author/creator meta tags present
Keywords meta tag present (12 keywords)

findings.title: Missing og:image and twitter:image
findings.description: twitter:card is set to summary_large_image but no image exists. Every social share renders with no preview image.
findings.recommendation: Create 1200×630px OG image and wire into metadata.openGraph.images and metadata.twitter.images in layout.tsx

findings.title: Single-page architecture limits internal linking
findings.description: Zero internal page links — all navigation uses anchor jumps on one URL. No PageRank distribution possible.
findings.recommendation: Create individual routes for project case studies (/projects/[slug]) to build internal link structure

findings.title: H1 contains only name, no role keyword
findings.description: H1 is 'Rahul Motvani' without any role keywords. Role keywords appear in surrounding text but not the H1 itself.
findings.recommendation: Consider 'Rahul Motvani — DevOps & Cloud Infrastructure Engineer' for H1

findings.title: Zero structured data on entire site
findings.description: Confirmed zero JSON-LD, Microdata, or RDFa via both live fetch and source code inspection. No entity markup for Person, ProfilePage, or WebSite.
findings.recommendation: Add ProfilePage/Person JSON-LD (with name, jobTitle, sameAs, knowsAbout, hasCredential) and WebSite JSON-LD to layout.tsx

findings.title: Certification credentials have no verification URLs
findings.description: portfolioData.ts has a credentialUrl field on all 4 certifications but none are populated. Prevents schema from including verification links.
findings.recommendation: Add Credly/Coursera/Cisco verification URLs to each certification entry

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Zero third-party JavaScript
Brotli compression active
Font preloading for 2 primary woff2 fonts
next/font optimization with next-size-adjust meta
All JS chunks loaded async
CDN caching via Cloudflare + Fastly

findings.title: Oversized JavaScript bundle
findings.description: 822KB total JS across 7 chunks for a static portfolio. Even with Brotli (~270KB transferred), this is excessive.
findings.recommendation: Lazy-load below-fold interactive sections (Architecture Explorer, SRE Sandbox) using next/dynamic. Target <400KB.

findings.title: Large HTML document
findings.description: 174KB HTML with all project data inline. Increases TTFB and time-to-interactive.
findings.recommendation: Consider lighter initial shell with dynamic imports for project detail data

findings.title: Excessive font files
findings.description: 14 woff2 files totaling 321KB. Most are likely unnecessary character subsets for an English-only site.
findings.recommendation: Audit next/font configuration — limit to Latin subset only for Inter and Fira Code

findings.title: Borderline TTFB
findings.description: ~730ms TTFB due to double-CDN (Cloudflare → Fastly/GitHub Pages).
findings.recommendation: Consider Cloudflare 'Cache Everything' page rule or migrating to Cloudflare Pages

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: Static export — content in initial HTML, no JS execution required for crawlers
Strong factual content with quantified claims
PerplexityBot and OAI-SearchBot allowed
Real LinkedIn and GitHub presence for entity grounding

findings.title: AI crawlers blocked by Cloudflare edge injection
findings.description: Cloudflare's AI Crawl Control injects Disallow rules for GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, and 5 more bots. This is NOT in the repo's robots.txt — it's a dashboard setting.
findings.recommendation: Cloudflare → Security → Bots → AI Scrapers → Unblock GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended

findings.title: No llms.txt file
findings.description: /llms.txt returns 404. No machine-readable summary for AI models exists.
findings.recommendation: Create public/llms.txt with structured identity/skills/projects/certifications summary

findings.title: Zero YouTube/Reddit/Wikipedia brand signals
findings.description: YouTube presence (~0.737 correlation with AI citations) is completely absent. No Reddit or Wikipedia entity.
findings.recommendation: Publish a project walkthrough video on YouTube and link from portfolio

findings.title: Single-URL architecture limits citation precision
findings.description: All content on one URL — AI citations always point to generic homepage regardless of which fact is cited.
findings.recommendation: Split project case studies into individual routes for per-topic citation precision

categories.name: Images
what_works: No oversized images (because there are no images)
SVG icons via Lucide React — lightweight, scalable

findings.title: Zero raster images on entire site
findings.description: No profile photo, no project screenshots, no architecture diagrams as images. Only 2 external Wikipedia SVGs and a decorative grid.svg.
findings.recommendation: Add professional headshot, project screenshots, and architecture diagrams as static images

findings.title: No OG image for social sharing
findings.description: og:image and twitter:image both absent. Social shares render with no visual preview.
findings.recommendation: Create and add 1200×630px branded OG image to public/

findings.title: No favicon
findings.description: favicon.ico returns 404. No link rel=icon in HTML. Missing from browser tabs, bookmarks, SERP display.
findings.recommendation: Add favicon.ico (32×32) + apple-touch-icon (180×180) to public/
